hero.title: You're doing RAG wrong
hero.en: There's a new approach that: cuts corpus size by 40x. reduces tokens per query by 3x. improves vector search relevance by 2.3x. And it doesn't touch your retrieval algorithm, your reranker, or your embedding model. It fixes something upstream that almost no one examines. Every RAG pipeline starts with the same assumption: a chunk of text is the right unit of knowledge to embed. That assumption is almost never examined. And it's the source of most of the retrieval failures people try to fix downstream.
hero.zh: 文章指出，RAG 的许多失败并不一定来自检索算法、reranker 或 embedding model，而是来自更上游的默认假设：把一段文本 chunk 当作知识嵌入的基本单位。作者声称，新的预处理方式可以让语料规模减少 40x、每次查询 token 减少 3x，并将向量检索相关性提升 2.3x。

sections.toc: 为什么 chunk 不是好的知识单元
sections.title: 为什么 chunk 不是好的知识单元

rows.en: A chunk of text is a structurally neutral container. It knows nothing about: where its ideas begin or end which version of a document it came from who is allowed to see it Since a chunk has no idea boundary, the splitter cuts wherever the token count runs out. You end up retrieving half a table, or a conclusion with no argument, or a claim stripped of the context that makes it true. The model has no way to know what’s missing. The version problem is just as bad. Most enterprise corpora have the same document in a dozen near-identical versions across SharePoint, Confluence, and Git. Top-K retrieval returns five copies of the same paragraph, current and deprecated mixed together. The LLM blends them into an answer that’s confidently wrong. Because the chunk carries no metadata either, there’s nowhere to attach access control in the data itself. Role filters, version state, clearance level: all of that ends up as logic bolted onto the orchestrator, disconnected from the content it’s supposed to govern. LangChain, LlamaIndex, and Haystack sit above all of this. They orchestrate retrieval from whatever you put in the vector store. Most stacks have nothing between the document parser and the vector store. That gap is where all three problems compound.
rows.zh: chunk 只是结构中性的容器，不知道观点边界、文档版本，也不知道访问权限。按 token 数切分会造成半张表、缺少论证的结论、脱离上下文的声明被检索出来；企业语料中的重复版本还会让 Top-K 返回多个近似段落，混合当前版和废弃版。访问控制、版本状态和权限等级如果只挂在编排器上，就会与内容本身脱节。

rows.en: The chunk fails because it’s structurally agnostic. The fix is to make the unit of knowledge structurally explicit. Instead of embedding a window of prose, you embed a claim: one question, its validated answer, and governance fields as typed schema. One fact per unit, nothing more. Your queries are already questions. When your index stores answers to questions, the match becomes structural, not just semantic. You’re not hoping the right paragraph floats to the top. You’re matching a question to its answer directly. Blockify, a preprocessing layer from Iternal Technologies, implements this as a structure it calls an IdeaBlock: a question, its validated answer, and typed governance fields like clearance level, version state, and source, all on the same object. It mirrors the shape of how users actually query a RAG system, as questions. The key insight: when you embed a question-answer packet instead of a text window, your embedding represents a single atomic claim, not a chunk of narrative that happens to contain it. This has a measurable consequence on vector geometry. In Blockify’s internal benchmark across 17 documents and 298 pages, the average cosine distance from query to best-matching block was 0.1585 for IdeaBlocks versus 0.3624 for naive chunks. That’s a 2.29x reduction in retrieval distance.
rows.zh: 作者提出的替代单位是 Question-Answer Packet：一个问题、一个经过验证的答案，以及以类型化 schema 表示的治理字段。Blockify 将这种结构称为 IdeaBlock，把 clearance level、version state、source 等字段与答案放在同一个对象上。由于用户查询天然是问题，索引中也存储问题对应的答案，匹配就从单纯语义相似变成结构匹配。作者引用 Blockify 内部基准：在 17 份文档、298 页数据上，IdeaBlocks 的平均余弦距离为 0.1585，naive chunks 为 0.3624，检索距离降低 2.29x。

sections.toc: 反直觉结果：更少数据带来更高准确性
sections.title: 反直觉结果：更少数据带来更高准确性

rows.en: Most people expect that shrinking the corpus hurts retrieval. That’s not what happens with semantic distillation. In Blockify’s internal benchmark, the pipeline produced 2,042 raw IdeaBlocks from the source documents. After iterative deduplication at 80-85% similarity across 3-5 rounds: 2,042 blocks collapsed to 1,200 canonical IdeaBlocks Word count dropped from 88,877 to 44,537 Distilled dataset outperformed undistilled by 13.55% on vector accuracy The reason redundant copies hurt rather than help: fifteen near-duplicates of the same paragraph create fifteen competing vectors in the same region of embedding space. Retrieval distributes probability mass across all of them, pulling the match score down for the canonical version. Collapse them into one canonical block and the signal sharpens. Your vector index isn’t a hard drive you want to fill. It’s a retrieval surface, and redundancy degrades it.
rows.zh: 语义蒸馏的反直觉之处在于，缩小语料并不必然损害检索。作者给出的 Blockify 内部基准显示，2,042 个原始 IdeaBlocks 经 3 到 5 轮、80-85% 相似度阈值的迭代去重后，压缩为 1,200 个 canonical IdeaBlocks；词数从 88,877 降至 44,537；蒸馏后的数据集在向量准确性上高出 13.55%。原因是大量近重复段落会在 embedding 空间中互相竞争，分散检索概率质量。

sections.toc: 从文档到 IdeaBlocks 的七阶段管线
sections.title: 从文档到 IdeaBlocks 的七阶段管线

rows.en: The fix is a preprocessing pipeline that runs before anything touches the vector store. Blockify’s processing runs in seven stages. Each stage has a defined input and output, so failures are localizable and reproducible. Stage 1: Scoping Before any document is parsed, you define the index hierarchy: Organization > Business Unit > Product > Persona. This determines which blocks get tagged to which access tier and shapes how deduplication runs later. Stage 2: Ingestion Documents enter as DOCX, PDF, PPT, PNG/JPG, Markdown, or HTML. The parser hands off to the LLM layer, running fine-tuned LLaMA 3/QWEN 3.5/Gemma4 (and other custom foundation model variants), which converts raw chunks into draft IdeaBlocks: one critical question, one validated answer of two to three sentences, and typed governance fields. Input size is bounded at 1,000 to 4,000 characters, with 2,000 as the practical midpoint. Stage 3: Chunking and extraction Context-aware splitting means the LLM converts chunks to draft IdeaBlocks rather than cutting on token count alone. The output of each chunk is a question-answer pair, not a window of prose. Stage 4: Semantic deduplication This is where the retrieval surface gets cleaned. Blocks are clustered by cosine similarity at an 80-85% threshold across three to five iterative rounds. Near-duplicates merge into a single canonical block via a second specially tuned LLM. The pipeline is optimized for GPU, but you can also run it on extra CPU capacity via the Intel Xeon optimized version. The result is a dataset where every vector in the index represents a distinct claim, not one of fifteen near-identical copies competing for the same retrieval slot. Stage 5: Auto-tagging Each block receives typed metadata: clearance level (PUBLIC, INTERNAL, CONFIDENTIAL, SECRET), version state (Current, Deprecated, Draft, Approved), product line, export control flags, and data privacy labels. Applied by the pipeline, not the document author. Stage 6: Human validation A product corpus of 2,000 to 3,000 IdeaBlocks splits across five to ten SMEs, each spending one to two hours per quarter on their slice. Structured claims with source citations attached, not raw documents. Stage 7: Export Validated blocks push to the vector database via API or export as JSON-L. Supported vector stores: Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Milvus, Vertex Matching Engine. Supported embedding models: OpenAI, Bedrock, Mistral, Jina, open-source. The pipeline sits between document parser and vector store regardless of which combination is in use.
rows.zh: 作者把改造点放在进入向量库之前的预处理层。Blockify 的流程包含七步：先定义 Organization、Business Unit、Product、Persona 等索引层级；再接收 DOCX、PDF、PPT、图片、Markdown、HTML 等文档；由 LLM 层把原始 chunk 转为草稿 IdeaBlocks；然后做语义去重、自动打治理标签、交给领域专家验证，最后通过 API 或 JSON-L 导出到向量数据库。重点是让每个向量代表一个不同声明，而不是许多近重复段落之一。

sections.toc: 应用层会发生什么变化
sections.title: 应用层会发生什么变化

rows.en: The unit you embed determines what the application layer can do. Query construction gets simpler: your queries are already questions. When the index stores answers to questions, the match is structural rather than probabilistic. You stop tuning similarity thresholds to compensate for semantic mismatch between query shape and document shape. Governance moves into the data layer: role-based access, version state, clearance level are typed fields on each block, not logic bolted onto the orchestrator. A sales engineer querying the same index as a legal reviewer gets a different dataset not because the retrieval layer filters it, but because the blocks themselves carry the access boundary. Updates propagate from a single record: when a spec changes, you update one IdeaBlock. Every application querying that block gets the corrected answer on the next request. With naive chunking, the same fact lives in dozens of near-duplicate passages across multiple documents. Updating it means finding all of them, which at enterprise scale is not a tractable problem. The architecture doesn’t change how you query. It changes what you can trust about the answer.
rows.zh: 嵌入的知识单位决定应用层能做什么。查询构造会更简单，因为查询本来就是问题，而索引中存的是问题的答案；治理也会下沉到数据层，因为角色访问、版本状态和权限等级成为每个 block 的类型化字段；更新则可以从单条记录传播，规格变化时更新一个 IdeaBlock，所有查询该 block 的应用下次即可得到修正答案。架构并不改变查询方式，而是改变你能否信任答案。

sections.toc: 底层原则：修正单位，而不是继续补丁检索层
sections.title: 底层原则：修正单位，而不是继续补丁检索层

rows.en: The chunk is a parsing convenience that became a retrieval assumption. It has no idea boundary, version context or access state. Retrieval stacks have spent years patching that mismatch: rerankers, hybrid search, threshold tuning, prompt engineering. All of it downstream of the real problem. The fix is not a better retrieval algorithm. It’s a better unit. RAG stacks are beginning to grow a distillation layer between parsing and vectorization, the way web stacks grew a CDN layer between origin and browser. You can build it yourself with clustering, LLM-based summarization, and schema enforcement. Or you can use something purpose-built for it like Blockify. Either way, the chunk-as-unit assumption is the bug, and fixing it at the data layer pays off more than tuning retrieval ever will.
rows.zh: 作者的底层判断是：chunk 原本只是解析便利，却被误当成检索假设。它没有观点边界、版本上下文和访问状态，导致检索栈长期用 reranker、hybrid search、阈值调参和 prompt engineering 在下游修补。真正的修复不是更好的检索算法，而是更好的知识单位。RAG 栈正在 parsing 和 vectorization 之间长出蒸馏层，就像 Web 栈在 origin 和 browser 之间长出 CDN 层。

Stage 1: Scoping

Before any document is parsed, you define the index hierarchy: Organization > Business Unit > Product > Persona.

This determines which blocks get tagged to which access tier and shapes how deduplication runs later.

Stage 2: Ingestion

Documents enter as DOCX, PDF, PPT, PNG/JPG, Markdown, or HTML.

The parser hands off to the LLM layer, running fine-tuned LLaMA 3/QWEN 3.5/Gemma4 (and other custom foundation model variants), which converts raw chunks into draft IdeaBlocks: one critical question, one validated answer of two to three sentences, and typed governance fields.

Input size is bounded at 1,000 to 4,000 characters, with 2,000 as the practical midpoint.

Stage 3: Chunking and extraction

Context-aware splitting means the LLM converts chunks to draft IdeaBlocks rather than cutting on token count alone. The output of each chunk is a question-answer pair, not a window of prose.

Stage 4: Semantic deduplication

This is where the retrieval surface gets cleaned.

Blocks are clustered by cosine similarity at an 80-85% threshold across three to five iterative rounds.

Near-duplicates merge into a single canonical block via a second specially tuned LLM. The pipeline is optimized for GPU, but you can also run it on extra CPU capacity via the Intel Xeon optimized version.

The result is a dataset where every vector in the index represents a distinct claim, not one of fifteen near-identical copies competing for the same retrieval slot.

Stage 5: Auto-tagging

Each block receives typed metadata: clearance level (PUBLIC, INTERNAL, CONFIDENTIAL, SECRET), version state (Current, Deprecated, Draft, Approved), product line, export control flags, and data privacy labels. Applied by the pipeline, not the document author.

Stage 6: Human validation

A product corpus of 2,000 to 3,000 IdeaBlocks splits across five to ten SMEs, each spending one to two hours per quarter on their slice. Structured claims with source citations attached, not raw documents.

Stage 7: Export

Validated blocks push to the vector database via API or export as JSON-L. Supported vector stores: Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Milvus, Vertex Matching Engine. Supported embedding models: OpenAI, Bedrock, Mistral, Jina, open-source.

The pipeline sits between document parser and vector store regardless of which combination is in use.

rows.en: The unit you embed determines what the application layer can do.

rows.caption: 知识单位变化后，查询、治理和更新传播都进入更明确的数据结构。

rows.en: Query construction gets simpler: your queries are already questions. When the index stores answers to questions, the match is structural rather than probabilistic. You stop tuning similarity thresholds to compensate for semantic mismatch between query shape and document shape. Governance moves into the data layer: role-based access, version state, clearance level are typed fields on each block, not logic bolted onto the orchestrator. A sales engineer querying the same index as a legal reviewer gets a different dataset not because the retrieval layer filters it, but because the blocks themselves carry the access boundary. Updates propagate from a single record: when a spec changes, you update one IdeaBlock. Every application querying that block gets the corrected answer on the next request. With naive chunking, the same fact lives in dozens of near-duplicate passages across multiple documents. Updating it means finding all of them, which at enterprise scale is not a tractable problem. The architecture doesn’t change how you query. It changes what you can trust about the answer.

rows.en: The chunk is a parsing convenience that became a retrieval assumption. It has no idea boundary, version context or access state. Retrieval stacks have spent years patching that mismatch: rerankers, hybrid search, threshold tuning, prompt engineering. All of it downstream of the real problem. The fix is not a better retrieval algorithm. It’s a better unit. search.eg: It improves vector search relevance by 2.3x.
search.egzh: 它将向量检索相关性提升 2.3x。

ideablock.def: Blockify 中的问题-答案知识单元，包含问题、验证答案和治理字段。
ideablock.eg: Blockify implements this as a structure it calls an IdeaBlock.
ideablock.egzh: Blockify 将这种结构实现为它称作 IdeaBlock 的对象。

schema.def: 模式；定义数据字段、类型和结构的约束。
schema.eg: You embed a claim with governance fields as typed schema.
schema.egzh: 你嵌入的是一个带有类型化 schema 治理字段的声明。

governance.def: 治理；对权限、版本、来源、隐私等规则的结构化管理。
governance.eg: Governance moves into the data layer.

deduplication.def: 去重；合并或删除重复、近重复内容的过程。
deduplication.eg: After iterative deduplication at 80-85% similarity across 3-5 rounds.
deduplication.egzh: 经过 3 到 5 轮、80-85% 相似度阈值的迭代去重之后。

canonical.def: 规范的、标准的；在多个近似版本中保留为权威版本的。
canonical.eg: Collapse them into one canonical block and the signal sharpens.
canonical.egzh: 把它们合并成一个 canonical block 后，信号会变得更清晰。

retrieval.def: 检索；从语料或索引中取回相关信息。
retrieval.eg: Fixing it at the data layer pays off more than tuning retrieval ever will.
retrieval.egzh: 在数据层修复它比调优 retrieval 更有收益。

orchestrator.def: 编排器；负责组织流程、工具调用和执行逻辑的系统层。
orchestrator.eg: All of that ends up as logic bolted onto the orchestrator.
orchestrator.egzh: 这些最终都变成附着在 orchestrator 上的逻辑。

clearance.def: 许可、权限；本文中指访问权限等级。
clearance.eg: Each block receives typed metadata: clearance level.
clearance.egzh: 每个 block 都获得类型化元数据：clearance level。

version.def: 版本；文档或记录的状态变体。
version.eg: The version problem is just as bad.

semantic.def: 语义的；与意义表示相关。
semantic.eg: That is not what happens with semantic distillation.
semantic.egzh: semantic distillation 中并不会发生这种情况。

distillation.def: 蒸馏；将复杂或冗余内容压缩成更精炼表示的过程。
distillation.eg: That is not what happens with semantic distillation.
distillation.egzh: semantic distillation 中并不会发生这种情况。

algorithm.def: 算法；解决问题的一组步骤或规则。
algorithm.eg: The fix is not a better retrieval algorithm.
algorithm.egzh: 修复点不是更好的检索算法。

model.def: 模型；本文中指 LLM 或 embedding model。
model.eg: It does not touch your embedding model.
model.egzh: 它不改动你的 embedding model。

upstream.def: 上游的；发生在流程早期的位置。
upstream.eg: It fixes something upstream that almost no one examines.
upstream.egzh: 它修复的是几乎没人检查的上游问题。

assumption.def: 假设；未经充分检验的默认前提。
assumption.eg: That assumption is almost never examined.
assumption.egzh: 这个假设几乎从未被审视。

pipeline.def: 管线；由多个处理阶段组成的数据流程。
pipeline.eg: The fix is a preprocessing pipeline.
pipeline.egzh: 修复方式是一条预处理管线。

failure.def: 失败；未达到预期的结果。
failure.eg: It is the source of most retrieval failures.
failure.egzh: 它是许多检索失败的来源。

downstream.def: 下游的；发生在流程较晚位置的。
downstream.eg: All of it downstream of the real problem.
downstream.egzh: 这些都位于真正问题的下游。

structurally.eg: The chunk fails because it is structurally agnostic.
structurally.egzh: chunk 失败是因为它在结构上无感知。

neutral.def: 中性的；不携带特定结构或立场的。
neutral.eg: A chunk of text is a structurally neutral container.
neutral.egzh: 文本 chunk 是结构中性的容器。

container.eg: A chunk of text is a structurally neutral container.
container.egzh: 文本 chunk 是结构中性的容器。

document.def: 文档；企业知识库中的内容来源。
document.eg: Most enterprise corpora have the same document in many versions.
document.egzh: 多数企业语料中同一文档有多个版本。

token.def: 令牌；模型处理文本时的基本计量单位。
token.eg: It reduces tokens per query by 3x.
token.egzh: 它让每次查询 token 减少 3x。

table.def: 表格；结构化信息的一种形式。
table.eg: You end up retrieving half a table.
table.egzh: 你最终可能检索到半张表。

conclusion.eg: You retrieve a conclusion with no argument.
conclusion.egzh: 你会检索到没有论证支撑的结论。

argument.def: 论证；支撑结论的理由链。
argument.eg: You retrieve a conclusion with no argument.
argument.egzh: 你会检索到没有论证支撑的结论。

claim.def: 声明、主张；本文中指可验证的原子事实。

context.def: 上下文；使声明成立的周边信息。
context.eg: The model has no way to know what context is missing.
context.egzh: 模型无法知道缺少了哪些上下文。

enterprise.def: 企业；本文中特指企业级语料环境。
enterprise.eg: Most enterprise corpora have the same document in many versions.
enterprise.egzh: 多数企业语料中同一文档有多个版本。

paragraph.eg: Top-K retrieval returns five copies of the same paragraph.
paragraph.egzh: Top-K 检索返回同一段落的多个副本。

deprecated.def: 已废弃的；不应再作为当前答案依据的。
deprecated.eg: Current and deprecated are mixed together.
deprecated.egzh: 当前版和废弃版混在一起。

metadata.def: 元数据；描述内容属性的数据。

filter.def: 过滤器；用于筛选内容的规则。
filter.eg: Role filters end up as logic bolted onto the orchestrator.
filter.egzh: 角色过滤器最终变成附着在编排器上的逻辑。

store.def: 存储；本文中指 vector store。
store.eg: Most stacks have nothing between parser and vector store.
store.egzh: 多数技术栈在 parser 和 vector store 之间没有任何层。

packet.def: 包；本文中指问题-答案数据单元。
packet.eg: A Better Unit: The Question-Answer Packet.
packet.egzh: 更好的单位是 Question-Answer Packet。

validated.def: 经过验证的；已确认正确或可靠的。
validated.eg: One question, its validated answer, and governance fields.
validated.egzh: 一个问题、经过验证的答案和治理字段。

answer.def: 答案；与问题对应的知识内容。
answer.eg: You are matching a question to its answer directly.
answer.egzh: 你是在直接匹配问题和答案。

atomic.def: 原子的；不可再分的最小语义单元。

geometry.def: 几何；本文中指向量空间中的距离关系。
geometry.eg: This has a measurable consequence on vector geometry.
geometry.egzh: 这会对向量几何产生可度量的影响。

benchmark.def: 基准测试；用于比较性能的数据实验。
benchmark.egzh: 在 Blockify 的内部基准中。

cosine.def: 余弦；用于衡量向量相似度的数学概念。
cosine.egzh: 平均余弦距离为 文中给出的数值。

distance.def: 距离；本文中指向量间距离。
distance.eg: That is a 2.29x reduction in retrieval distance.

naive.def: 朴素的；未做结构化改造的。
naive.egzh: IdeaBlocks 与 naive chunks 的对比。

accuracy.def: 准确性；结果正确或相关的程度。
accuracy.eg: The distilled dataset outperformed by 13.55% on vector accuracy.
accuracy.egzh: 蒸馏后的数据集在向量准确性上高出 文中给出的百分比。

redundant.def: 冗余的；重复且降低信号质量的。
redundant.eg: Redundant copies hurt rather than help.
redundant.egzh: 冗余副本有害而不是有益。

duplicate.def: 重复项；与其他内容高度相似的副本。
duplicate.egzh: 十五个近重复项会形成竞争向量。

surface.def: 表面；本文中指检索空间的有效形状。

stage.def: 阶段；处理管线中的步骤。
stage.eg: Each stage has a defined input and output.
stage.egzh: 每个阶段都有明确输入和输出。

scoping.def: 定界；定义索引层级和处理范围的阶段。

ingestion.def: 摄取；将文档输入处理系统的过程。

parser.def: 解析器；把文档转换成可处理内容的组件。
parser.eg: The parser hands off to the LLM layer.
parser.egzh: parser 将内容交给 LLM 层。

llm.def: 大语言模型；用于生成、理解或转换文本的模型。
llm.eg: The parser hands off to the LLM layer.
llm.egzh: parser 将内容交给 LLM 层。

threshold.def: 阈值；触发某个操作的界限。
threshold.eg: Blocks are clustered by cosine similarity at an 80-85% threshold.
threshold.egzh: blocks 按 80-85% 相似度阈值聚类。

gpu.def: 图形处理器；用于加速并行计算的硬件。
gpu.eg: The pipeline is optimized for GPU.
gpu.egzh: 该管线针对 GPU 优化。

validation.def: 验证；由人或系统确认内容可靠性的过程。

export.def: 导出；将验证结果输出到外部系统。
export.eg: Validated blocks push to the vector database via API or export as JSON-L.
export.egzh: 验证后的 blocks 通过 API 推送到向量数据库或导出为 JSON-L。

database.def: 数据库；存储和查询数据的系统。
database.eg: Validated blocks push to the vector database.
database.egzh: 验证后的 blocks 推送到向量数据库。

privacy.def: 隐私；对敏感信息的保护。
privacy.eg: Each block receives data privacy labels.
privacy.egzh: 每个 block 都会获得数据隐私标签。
